$comment: Copy this file to benchmark/targets.json (gitignored) and fill in the seams.
Anything left null/absent is treated as 'not configured' and its scenarios are
skipped with a clear note rather than failing the run. Env vars override file
values (see benchmark/lib/targets.mjs for the precedence + the exact var names).
The local GoatCitadel gateway. If baseUrl is null the runner can auto-spin an
isolated verification stack (scripts/verification/lib/runtime.mjs) for the HTTP
scenarios when invoked with --spin. The in-process TRUST/RELIABILITY scenarios
(deny-wins Ward, dry-run hash mismatch, unknown-sender allowlist, orphan child)
import the SHIPPED dist/ logic and need neither a baseUrl nor keys.

auth.$comment: mode 'loopback' relies on GOATCITADEL_AUTH_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_BYPASS; 'token' sends Authorization: Bearer <token>.
